tagline: Global Leader in Outsourced Semiconductor Packaging and Test Services
hero_kpi_rationale: Amkor positions itself as a leader in advanced semiconductor packaging and test solutions, particularly for high-growth markets such as AI, high-performance computing (HPC), automotive, and data centers. These markets are the primary drivers of demand for higher-performance chips and innovative packaging solutions.

kpis.name: AI / HPC / Automotive Demand
kpis.explanation: Demand for semiconductor packaging and test services in the artificial intelligence, high-performance computing, automotive, and data center sectors.
kpis.description: Represents consolidated net sales, reflecting overall demand for Amkor's services in advanced applications.
kpis.signal: Growth driven by key technology markets.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue remaining after deducting cost of goods sold.
kpis.description: Gross margin indicates profitability of core operations before operating expenses.
kpis.signal: Margin under pressure due to start-up and operating costs.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue remaining after deducting operating costs.
kpis.description: Operating margin measures the profitability of the company's core business activities.
kpis.signal: Slight improvement despite gross margin pressures.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Amount invested in physical assets to support future growth.
kpis.description: Capital expenditures are crucial for capacity expansion and technological development. In 2025, investments reached 13.5% of net sales.
kpis.signal: Strategic investment in a new facility in Arizona and advanced equipment.

kpis.name: R&D Investments (% revenue)
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue dedicated to research and development of new technologies.
kpis.description: R&D spending is essential to maintain a competitive advantage in the technology sector. In 2025, R&D represents 2.5% of revenue.
kpis.signal: Ongoing commitment to innovation for high-end markets.

kpis.name: Cash and Equivalents
kpis.explanation: Available cash and assets easily convertible into cash.
kpis.description: Cash and cash equivalents are essential for financial flexibility and risk management.
kpis.signal: Strong liquidity position to fund operations and investments.

kpis.name: Vietnam Facility Ramp-Up
kpis.explanation: Initial high-volume production phase at the new Vietnam facility, opened in 2024, impacting margins in 2025.
kpis.description: The start-up of a new facility impacts costs and profitability in the short term, but is essential for future growth. Production at the Vietnam Facility is in the initial high-volume manufacturing phase.
kpis.signal: Negative impact on gross margin in 2025, indicator of capacity ramp-up.

kpis.name: Arizona Facility Construction
kpis.explanation: Commencement of construction of a new U.S. facility in the second half of 2025 to support supply chain regionalization.
kpis.description: This investment aims to enhance capacity to serve customers seeking to regionalize their supply chains and to participate in U.S. semiconductor initiatives. Construction began in the second half of 2025.
kpis.signal: Strategic investment to strengthen U.S. presence and respond to domestic initiatives.

risks.title: Industry Downturn
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to fluctuations in the semiconductor market, which can have a significant impact on its operating results. The cyclical nature of the semiconductor industry creates substantial risks of revenue and profitability volatility. (Item 1A, Item 7)

risks.title: Supplier Dependence
risks.score_rationale: The company relies on a limited number of suppliers for certain materials and components, which may create supply chain disruption risks. (Item 1A)

risks.title: Increased Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company faces increased competition in the semiconductor packaging and test services market, including in-house capabilities of IDMs and other competitors, which may affect its market share. (Item 1A)

risks.title: Cybersecurity Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to cybersecurity risks, particularly due to its reliance on information systems and sensitive data. (Item 1A)

risks.title: Price Fluctuations
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to fluctuations in the prices of materials and components, which may affect its costs and operating results. (Item 1A)

risks.title: Key Customer Dependence
risks.score_rationale: The company depends on a few key customers, which may create risks of revenue loss if these customers depart. (Item 1A)

risks.title: Regulatory and Trade Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to regulatory risks and changes in trade policy, including due to new tariffs and trade restrictions. (Item 7 MD&A)

ai_positioning.summary: Amkor positions itself as a leader in semiconductor packaging and test solutions for AI and high-performance computing applications. The company is actively developing advanced packaging technologies specifically targeted to support the growing demands of AI applications, particularly in the high-performance computing and data center segments.
evidence: Comprehensive portfolio includes advanced packaging solutions targeting AI applications for data centers and high-performance computing
Collaborating with industry leaders in HPC and AI markets as key strategic end markets
Strong position in developing advanced technologies such as HDFO, 2.5D integration, and advanced flip chip for AI-related computing infrastructure
